notes: Owner decision 2026-09-20: raise the Muse parallel-worker ceiling from the default 3 to 5 (the harness HARD_MAX) so a bounded swarm of headless muse-worker delegations can run at once. Everything else stays at strict defaults on purpose: worker_network restricted, web off for investigate/worker, max_effort xhigh, max_steps 60, max_timeout_seconds 1800, max_sweep_targets 8, model unpinned (the CLI's muse-spark-1.3-contributor pin applies; the owner confirmed contributor/data-use is acceptable for this repo, and tier.json flags.sensitive_data is false). 5 is a ceiling, not a target: the standing concurrency guidance is to run 3 heavy agents and reserve the extra slots for genuinely disjoint work. Push, pull-request, merge and deploy are not declarable here and remain undelegated.
